method: Sauté the chopped tomatoes in a little oil, then add the cleaned, fiber-less tamarind and sauté together.
Once the sautéed mixture cools, grind it in a mixer to a smooth paste.
Peel the garlic cloves and keep them ready.
Heat the gingelly oil in a pan, temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves.
Add the peeled garlic and sauté until they turn translucent.
Add the ground tomato-tamarind paste to the pan and mix well.
Add the red chili powder and salt powder, and continue to sauté until the oil separates and the pickle thickens.
Allow it to cool completely and store in a clean, dry glass jar.
notes: Note: Don't forget to add chili powder and salt as per the original snippet instructions.
